Hero_Desc_Neti:
An archaeologist Dragon who goes wherever relics can be found.
For the sake of a relic, she will bring out her drill regardless of the time or place.
Under Daya's orders, she is also responsible for excavating raw gems.
Album_Like_Neti: Exploring ruins, raw gems, zoning out while thinking about relics
Album_Hate_Neti: Bombs, and anyone constantly eyeing her relics
Album_Wish_Neti: For every ruin and raw gem to be excavated safely
Album_Neti1: My first meeting with Neti, a magnetite Dragon, was quite memorable. The ring of keys in my pocket began moving on its own as though drawn by something, then snapped onto Neti as she passed nearby. Neti and I spent half the day struggling to pull them free. Once the keys were rescued, Neti coolly said goodbye and left as if this happened all the time.
Album_Neti2: Neti is an archaeologist who excavates and preserves relics throughout Elias, as well as the Dragon newly assigned to excavation work. She says her magnetic nature led her into both roles. Despite her usual absent-minded appearance, she seems to be an exceptionally diligent Dragon.
Album_Neti3: Neti is apparently an exploration partner of Marie, the adventurer from the Sprite Kingdom. Neti treats relics like sacred treasures, while Marie blows up not only relics but entire ruins... Suddenly, I became very curious to see the two of them exploring together.
Album_Neti4: Neti's obsession with relics is intense enough to call to mind a certain someone from the Fairy Kingdom's back alleys. Neti usually gives away or donates relics she has ruled out as targets. But if a relic has caught her eye, or might catch it in the future, ownership must belong to Neti without exception.
Album_Neti5: While walking through the Dragon territory, I found Neti staring blankly at the ground. When I asked why she was sitting there in a daze, she replied that she was actually deep in thought about relics she had excavated and raw gems that had caught her attention.
Album_Neti6: I saw Neti strolling along with Leets stuck to her back. The berserk Leets flailed wildly behind her, while Neti looked as serene as ever. Thinking she might need help, I called out to her. Neti merely said that time would solve everything and continued on her way.
Album_Neti7: As I listened to Neti talk about relics as usual, she thanked me for hearing her out. In this world, most people ignore her a hundred times even after she explains a relic's value a hundred times. In return, I asked her to show me her favorite relic someday. She gave a languid smile and said she would think about it.
LoveHero_Neti: It is an honor to have you as my exploration buddy, you know.
LoveHeroCancel_Neti: You must put the relics back before you leave, understood?
Food_ChefNote_Neti_Hate1: She says 90 percent of what she excavates near the Beastfolk Village is canned feed. The emptiness she feels upon finding canned feed underground is apparently beyond words...
Food_ChefNote_Neti_Hate2: She shook her head, saying it felt like expecting to find a relic only to encounter a completely empty space.
Food_ChefNote_Neti_Like1: After carefully appraising the jewels atop the tart, Neti declared that closer study was required and vanished with it in an instant. She looked excited, so I suppose it is fine...
Food_ChefNote_Neti_Like2: She says this is a nostalgic food she often ate in the Dragon caves before becoming an archaeologist. It brought back old memories, and she smiled.
Food_ChefNote_Neti_Like3: She asked what historical value and significance rice cake soup possessed, then began writing down every word of my answer. The soup had gone cold by then, but she still enjoyed it.
Food_ChefNote_Neti_Like4: Neti's eyes lit up, and in an instant she had excavated a tunnel through the buche de Noel. She gave an awkward laugh and blamed it on an occupational habit before eating it happily.
Food_ChefNote_Neti_Like5: She liked it, saying it would come in handy on distant expeditions. Would most people not say it looked good to eat...?
Food_ChefNote_Neti_Like6: She found the soft, chewy texture amusing and wagged her tail furiously. Eventually, it looked as though she had four tails.
Food_ChefNote_Neti_Like7: She eyed it suspiciously because it resembled a trapped gift chest. Once she inspected the contents, she lowered her guard and ate it with delight.
Food_ChefNote_Neti_Like8: After tasting the powder's refreshing tartness, she said a good research idea had struck her and spent quite some time writing in her notebook. Something about the benefits of stimulating flavors.
Food_ChefNote_Neti_Like9: She marveled that it looked just like a jewel. With a sly grin, she said that if she took one home and carefully buried it in the front yard, it might someday become a relic of immense value.

LoveLetter_Neti:
Master, it has been a long time since I last wrote a letter, you know! I always enjoy the food you serve me at the banquet hall. Even after a tiring day spent excavating newly arrived Dragons or digging through ruins, one meal from you at the banquet hall makes all that day's fatigue vanish, you know!

If the opportunity ever arises, I would love to excavate relics at a ruin together with you, Master! Exploring together and discovering a new relic would make me very happy, you know. And if we uncover an especially incredible relic while you are with me, I will even grant you first choice!
LoveCall_Neti:
Hello, Master. Have you been well, you know?

I was in such a good mood yesterday that I ended up digging all day.
It kept feeling as though a relic would appear if I dug just a little farther, so I kept tearing up the same spot until I had made an entire tunnel, you know!
But I did not find a single relic in the end... It made me so sad, you know.
I went into the tunnel to rest for a little while, and that was when I thought of you, Master.
The rich scent of earth made me feel so content, you know.

Master, would you like to visit the tunnel I made?
It is much too narrow for two people... but I think we could manage if we stayed very close together, you know.
Whenever I visit the banquet hall, you always listen to my stories...
So in the tunnel, I will listen to yours, Master!

I will be waiting, so I truly hope you come, you know.
Affinity_Neti_EP01_001: Master, what do you think a true relic is, you know?
Affinity_Neti_EP01_002: Something ancient and recognized as archaeologically valuable?
Affinity_Neti_EP01_003: Everyone thinks that. I wanted a more unusual perspective, so that is disappointing.
Affinity_Neti_EP01_004: Anything Neti excavates is a true relic!
Affinity_Neti_EP01_005: Hmm, perhaps so. Discovering value hidden beneath the earth... That is the work of an archaeologist.
Affinity_Neti_EP01_006: Does everything become a relic if it is simply old enough?
Affinity_Neti_EP01_007: Of course not! You will not become a relic simply by growing old either, Master.
Affinity_Neti_EP02_001: Because I am a magnetite Dragon, iron objects stick to me as I walk along.
Affinity_Neti_EP02_002: What a remarkable talent. Perhaps you are perfectly suited to running a scrapyard.
Affinity_Neti_EP02_003: Are you calling my relics scrap?!
Affinity_Neti_EP02_004: Oh? It must be nice never having to worry about losing your keys!
Affinity_Neti_EP02_005: Oh! Come to think of it, I do not think I have ever lost a key.
Affinity_Neti_EP02_006: Can you control flying swords through magnetism?
Affinity_Neti_EP02_007: What in the world are you talking about, Master...?
Affinity_Neti_EP03_001: Sometimes I cannot understand what Pira says.
Affinity_Neti_EP03_002: Those who win a showdown through dumb luck are the ones who put on airs!
Affinity_Neti_EP03_003: Ugh! I still cannot understand! But were you imitating Pira just now?
Affinity_Neti_EP03_004: I find Opal difficult too. She is a total Lucky Bibikidian, right? Ehe?
Affinity_Neti_EP03_005: Opal's speech is difficult too. But it sounded so cute when she said it...
Affinity_Neti_EP03_006: Tsk, you lack passion and effooort.
Affinity_Neti_EP03_007: What? I do not particularly want to devote passion and effort to that.
Affinity_Neti_EP04_001: Mayo recently gave me this and called it a relic. What is it?
Affinity_Neti_EP04_002: Fingernails, toenails, and hair? You would be better off throwing it away.
Affinity_Neti_EP04_003: Mayo said it was extremely precious. I do not know why, though.
Affinity_Neti_EP04_004: Ah, you do not know? Those are hidden fragments of the World Tree.
Affinity_Neti_EP04_005: Are you feeling unwell, Master? Shall I make an appointment at Monatium Hospital?
Affinity_Neti_EP04_006: I do not understand it either, but I heard those are fashionable among the Apostles.
Affinity_Neti_EP04_007: If they are fashionable, I should treasure them for now, you know!
Affinity_Neti_EP05_001: Sigh. Is there no magnificent ruin anywhere?
Affinity_Neti_EP05_002: Wherever Neti's drill breaks through, that place becomes a ruin!
Affinity_Neti_EP05_003: What? Then I will drill through the Banquet Hall floor immediately!
Affinity_Neti_EP05_004: Calm down. The Banquet Hall is definitely not one.
Affinity_Neti_EP05_005: I am not some Dragon who swings her drill around whenever she pleases!
Affinity_Neti_EP05_006: Is it not more magnificent precisely because it is difficult to find?
Affinity_Neti_EP05_007: I feel slightly deceived, but I suppose that is why ruins and relics are so precious.
Affinity_Neti_EP06_001: My drill is the drill that will pierce the heavens!
Affinity_Neti_EP06_002: I feel as though I have heard that line somewhere before.
Affinity_Neti_EP06_003: Who knows? Perhaps it is your imagination. Hmm? You look rather delighted.
Affinity_Neti_EP06_005: If you like drills that much, would you like one of your own, Master?
Affinity_Neti_EP06_006: What are we even talking about... Neti?
Affinity_Neti_EP06_007: Ah, shouting like that feels rather good.
Affinity_Neti_EP07_001: A magnificent companion is essential for exploring relics. Is there anyone suitable?
Affinity_Neti_EP07_002: How about Daya? She is intelligent and strong.
Affinity_Neti_EP07_003: Lady Daya is busy as leader of the Dragons. Is there anyone else?
Affinity_Neti_EP07_004: Marie would be good. She will set off plenty of bombs.
Affinity_Neti_EP07_005: Marie and I already explore together diligently.
Affinity_Neti_EP07_006: There is an explorer named Guin. How about her?
Affinity_Neti_EP07_007: Guin? The Penguinian? I should ask her, you know!
Affinity_Neti_EP08_001: I plan to infiltrate the Witch Library. I hear it holds many ancient books. Should I drill up through the floor?
Affinity_Neti_EP08_002: I recommend infiltrating it before dawn if possible.
Affinity_Neti_EP08_003: Do not worry! My plan is perfect. I am Neti the excavator, you know.
Affinity_Neti_EP08_004: Do not do that. Come with me. I have an entry pass.
Affinity_Neti_EP08_005: Oh, so there was another method. I leave it to you. I would like to borrow some ancient books from the Witch Library.
Affinity_Neti_EP08_006: I heard the Elven library is better.
Affinity_Neti_EP08_007: Someday I would like to dig through that place too. You do not happen to hold a grudge against the Elves, do you?
Affinity_Neti_EP09_001: I heard entering this coupon gives you a relic. Is that true?
Affinity_Neti_EP09_002: Did you perhaps receive it from Xion or Risty?
Affinity_Neti_EP09_003: It promised a relic, so I participated in Xion the Dark Bullet's web novel event and received it.
Affinity_Neti_EP09_004: That is not a relic. It is a coupon for an in-game item.
Affinity_Neti_EP09_005: What? Then why is it called a relic? A relic item? Did everyone name it that because they like relics?
Affinity_Neti_EP09_006: Register now! Get a relic item and 120 free pulls!
Affinity_Neti_EP09_007: What are you talking about, Master...? A free relic merely for registering...
Affinity_Neti_EP10_001: Recently, someone buried piles of household goods near my museum and pretended they were relics.
Affinity_Neti_EP10_003: Yes! How did you know? Whenever there is a problem, guessing the Elves makes you right half the time?
Affinity_Neti_EP10_004: Might those become relics someday too?
Affinity_Neti_EP10_005: That does not change the fact that this was illegal rubbish dumping.
Affinity_Neti_EP10_006: Then Neti can excavate all of it!
Affinity_Neti_EP10_007: I am an archaeologist, not a rubbish collector!
Affinity_Neti_EP11_001: Seeing broken relics makes me so upset.
Affinity_Neti_EP11_003: Excavation is more entertaining than restoration. I would rather spend that time digging more ground.
Affinity_Neti_EP11_004: Did you break them yourself and pretend not to know?
Affinity_Neti_EP11_005: What? What is that supposed to mean?! Do you think I am Marie?
Affinity_Neti_EP11_006: Let us hold a special exhibition of broken relics.
Affinity_Neti_EP11_007: What a reversal in thinking! Should I break a few more?
Affinity_Neti_EP12_001: Can you tell a chipped stone tool from an ordinary rock?
Affinity_Neti_EP12_002: With Neti's eye, you can distinguish them easily.
Affinity_Neti_EP12_003: Praise like that makes me happy. Of course I can tell them apart.
Affinity_Neti_EP12_005: I am a Dragon, so I should look for dragon-made marks. That idea is far too human-centered!
Affinity_Neti_EP12_007: Master, that is something you must never say, you know?
Affinity_Neti_EP13_001: I became excited when I found a cave painting, but it turned out to be quite recent...
Affinity_Neti_EP13_002: If it was drawn in crayon, I think I know which Sprite did it.
Affinity_Neti_EP13_003: Surely it is not the Sprite I know too...? Was her diary not enough?
Affinity_Neti_EP13_004: Cave paintings are like graffiti too.
Affinity_Neti_EP13_005: It is troubling that you understand archaeology so poorly... Though they are not entirely different...
Affinity_Neti_EP13_006: That graffiti will become a relic after several thousand years.
Affinity_Neti_EP13_007: Now that you mention it, you are right. I will preserve it from this moment onward!
Affinity_Neti_EP14_001: I want to buy new excavation tools. Please recommend something!
Affinity_Neti_EP14_003: Oh, good idea! Shall I pluck some tail fur from the Beastfolk?
Affinity_Neti_EP14_005: What?! What did I just hear?!
Affinity_Neti_EP14_007: A drill is better than a pickaxe~ I am an excavator who values speed, you know.
Affinity_Neti_EP15_001: I heard there is a witch who loves keeping records.
Affinity_Neti_EP15_002: In a way, recording things and excavating relics are similar.
Affinity_Neti_EP15_003: Exactly! It is the spirit of inquiry! The attitude of leaving one's name in history!
Affinity_Neti_EP15_004: She resembles you. I think the two of you would get along.
Affinity_Neti_EP15_005: Perhaps I should speak to her...? Please introduce us when she visits the Banquet Hall.
Affinity_Neti_EP15_006: Shall I bring you some of her records? They are relics, after all.
Affinity_Neti_EP15_007: That would be theft! Master, surely the relics I have lost until now were not also...
Affinity_Neti_EP16_001: Tell me about the greatest adventure of your life, Master!
Affinity_Neti_EP16_002: Perhaps we are always living as though life itself were an adventure.
Affinity_Neti_EP16_003: Do not try to sound impressive. Tell me about a real adventure! Ah... Have you never had one?
Affinity_Neti_EP16_004: I will tell you about traveling throughout all of Elias.
Affinity_Neti_EP16_005: Oh! I should sit down and eat popcorn while I listen! When, where, and how did you begin?
Affinity_Neti_EP16_006: I once went with Butter to dig up a place where some feed had been buried.
Affinity_Neti_EP16_007: That is cute, but it does not sound particularly exciting. Feed is difficult to count as a relic.
Affinity_Neti_EP17_001: If my ruin expeditions become a film, what should the title be?
Affinity_Neti_EP17_003: Your sense for titles is not very good, Master...
Affinity_Neti_EP17_005: Why is Jones attached to the end...?
Affinity_Neti_EP17_007: D-do I look somewhat great to you? How embarrassing...
Affinity_Neti_EP18_001: Mayor Elena says she will build a museum using the relics I collected...?
Affinity_Neti_EP18_002: Bring ten lawyers. Negotiate the contract thoroughly.
Affinity_Neti_EP18_003: I have already heard plenty about the Elves' reputation... Do not worry!
Affinity_Neti_EP18_005: Even you are in league with the mayor, Master... I am shocked!
Affinity_Neti_EP18_006: It is absolutely a fraud. Do not be deceived.
Affinity_Neti_EP18_007: That must be right, must it not? I should refuse!
Affinity_Neti_EP19_001: I want to research the ancient Dragon language.
Affinity_Neti_EP19_003: I feel as though they would scold me the instant I asked!
Affinity_Neti_EP19_004: Ask Jade for an old book.
Affinity_Neti_EP19_005: I would have to prepare myself for a trip to the weekend farm before asking...!
Affinity_Neti_EP19_006: Let us ask the witches who enjoy keeping records.
Affinity_Neti_EP19_007: Oh, what a change in perspective! Good idea!
Affinity_Neti_EP20_001: The Sprite Palace... It is so old. Could it be a relic?
Affinity_Neti_EP20_002: It has been repaired and renovated constantly, so it is practically a new palace.
Affinity_Neti_EP20_003: Repairs must be forbidden! It needs to become a relic!
Affinity_Neti_EP20_005: You do not have to say it quite so decisively!!
Affinity_Neti_EP20_006: Now that I think about it, you are right. We should preserve it.
Affinity_Neti_EP20_007: Then we must first remove all the Sprites inside! ...I am joking!
